LESSON: READING 11.2.1 INTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading, part of Strand 11 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read using technology? 2. How do you search for information using technology?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read animated stories, comics and cartoons interpretively, individually and collaboratively with peers,

2. watch videos or mimes and answer questions,

3. interpret visual representations such as mind maps,

4. carry out simple online research on topics related to the theme,

5. create simple crossword puzzles based on animated stories,

6. read a poem or story expressively to bring out varying emotions. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read animated stories, comics and cartoons interpretively, individually and collaboratively with peers,
2. watch videos or mimes and answer questions,
3. interpret visual representations such as mind maps,
4. carry out simple online research on topics related to the theme,
5. create simple crossword puzzles based on animated stories,
6. read a poem or story expressively to bring out varying emotions. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: This is developed when the learner engages in watching and interpreting mimes

and visuals.

• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced when the learner uses digital devices to read on issues or topics online and offline.

84

Values:
• Unity: This is developed as the learner works together with peers as they discuss and interpret visuals and mimes

collaboratively.

• Love: This is enhanced as the learner appreciates each other’s opinions in viewing and interpreting visuals

collaboratively.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-esteem is achieved as the learner’s confidence level is nurtured when they watch videos or mimes and answer

questions, interpret visual representations such as mind maps and carry out simple online research on how to play their

favourite game.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to apply research skills to look for information in all learning areas that they engage in.
